- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/lint_gh_calls_in_loops.py | lint() per-file except block, lines ~446-460
  PROBLEM: `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` is a subclass of `OSError`, so a future reorder of the except clauses would quietly turn TimeoutExpired into a `continue`.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to keep the TimeoutExpired clause first and add an inline comment that names the inheritance (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2).
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/lint_gh_calls_in_loops.py | lint() TimeoutExpired branch, ~line 451
  PROBLEM: The `::warning::` text "timed out reading <path>; remaining files skipped" is misleading when the timed-out path is the last one in `sorted(added)`.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to change the suffix to `"; further files skipped"` (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- HARDENING (not a finding): .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml | gh_loop_call_lint step, lines 290-291
  PROBLEM: If `rev-parse` stalls on both `--base` and `--head` (120 s each), the run could reach 330 s, past the 5-minute step timeout, and be killed before the `GH_LOOP_CALL_LINT` summary line prints.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to raise `timeout-minutes` to 6 or give the `_commit_exists` rev-parse calls a short timeout of ≤10 s each (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2).
